main.description: Lookup by thread: every conversation in which the caller wrote a MEK or is a MEK recipient, including conversations it has left ([CB-22]), ascending by conversation id. The caller's home DS merges its own conversations with those of every remote sequencer of a conversation the caller takes or took part in (labyrinthRelay listThreads); an unreachable sequencer fails the call with RelayUnavailable. Common errors: NotAuthorized, AccountSessionExpired, DeviceRevoked, RateLimited, InvalidRequest, PayloadTooLarge, QuotaExceeded.
